description: Audits a live public website and scores (0–100, grade A–F) how well AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and search engines can find, read and cite it. Checks robots.txt rules for AI and search crawlers, server-rendered text, business and FAQ structured data, Open Graph, llms.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, mobile viewport and response time. Returns each check with a plain-English fix, the top 3 fixes, and a shareable report link. Takes up to ~20 seconds.

url.description: Website to audit, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/
